name: AnimeClick Metadata
description: Provider metadati anime in italiano basato su AnimeClick.it con scraping etico e cache locale.
overview: Fornisce titoli, trame, generi, valutazioni e cover art in italiano per anime, utilizzando AnimeClick.it come fonte.

description: KometaThemes automatically downloads anime theme songs (OPs and EDs) from animethemes.moe. Features multi-provider resolution, intelligent title matching, parallel downloads, persistent cache, preview mode, synonym mappings, manual identification, and a bilingual Italian/English configuration UI.
name: KometaThemes
overview: Automatically downloads anime theme songs (OPs & EDs) from animethemes.moe with multi-provider resolution and intelligent title matching.
